title: Scenario
description: A scenario script (services/sim/scenarios/*.yaml) that injects story beats at set minutes so a demo match has a narrative arc.

home.description: Default home club when the CLI does not pass --home.

favourite.description: Which side the story treats as the favourite; the other side is the underdog.

scoring.description: free: shots score by the usual model. scripted: only goal beats score; every other shot that would have scored is saved.

stoppage_s.description: Override the stoppage-time range per period, in seconds.

Side.description: A venue, or a story role resolved through `favourite`.

at.description: Match minute the beat lands on: '71' means 71:00, '90+2' means 92:00 in second-half stoppage.

kind.description: goal: the team scores at (or just after) `at`. red_card: the team's next foul from `at` is a straight red. modifiers: from `at`, the team plays with these multipliers.

Modifiers.description: Multipliers on the engine's team model; 1.0 is neutral. Unset fields keep their current value.
